rv.q: Blood/Love is full of fun visuals, performances, and music, but this new musical ultimately doesn’t manage to sink its teeth into the story's emotional heft.
Blood/Love could be the silly, sensual distraction you need right now.
But I notice that I start cringing every time I see that facial expression because that’s about all we get from her.

cn.t: This vampire pop-rock opera earns praise for its campy fun and energetic musical numbers, though critics are divided on its substance—some find it thrillingly self-aware entertainment while others note it lacks depth.
